title: REST API & Spring MVC
intro: REST API interviews are the bread-and-butter backend surface. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with REST fundamentals (what REST is, the constraints, Richardson maturity), then request/response handling and Spring MVC controllers (the code tier). REST clients (RestClient, WebClient, Feign) follow, then the design tier — error handling, versioning, API design, HATEOAS, OpenAPI. HTTP caching closes the production tier, then comparisons and scenario-based questions.
